remarks: The perfect blend of everything you seek. Space to spread out, space to come together, multiple work/study-at-home options, beautiful property, serene views, a deck, stunning stone terrace, fire pit, large yard, neighborhood cul de sac, .25mi to trails of Wilton Town Forest, 1mi to Weir Farm National Park, top schools & an ideal location just off prestigious Nod Hill, close to Wilton & Ridgefield town centers, shopping, restaurants & multiple Metro-North stations! Classic New England charm at the front of the home married with more modern sophistication of floor to ceiling windows under a vaulted, wood planked cathedral ceiling toward the back. Every room is a treat, incl.the kitchen with its stainless-steel appliances, granite counter-tops, large dining area & open flow to the family room.  Take a look and see why 26 Patrick Ln is the perfect place to call home!
